text.title: Nadia's School Day
body: Nadia usually wakes up early and walks to school with her two friends.
Yesterday, she watched the sunrise from her window before leaving home.
She packed her books and opened the door quietly.
At school, the teacher collected the notebooks and checked the exercises.
Nadia's classmates were very excited about the upcoming photography competition.
Many students wanted to take beautiful pictures of the old buildings in the city centre.
Nadia decided to join the competition with her best friend.
